requirements.statement: The circus's monument is shrouded until B2 clears. It no longer stands uncovered from the start of the story.
requirements.spec_gap: The GDD does not say what the shroud looks like, what Arcade's Waterfront shows, or whether the shroud is solid or only a cover over the monument's existing footprint.

requirements.title: Unveil the monument with the run's plaque when B2 clears
requirements.statement: Clearing Waterfront B2 unveils the circus's monument. The plaque shows the run: chassis spent, points, best combo, time. The ship and the ending screen follow.
requirements.spec_gap: The GDD does not say: how long the unveiling lasts or how the player moves on; whether 'chassis spent' means chassis numbered or chassis written off; where the story-wide best combo is kept; the plaque's text and layout; what a reload during the finale resumes.

touches.why: a new phase 'unveil' before the ending, the plaque data, and progress.bestCombo
draw the unveiling and plaque; A continues
the monument uncovered

requirements.contract: When the certifying write-off clears Waterfront B2: progress.complete is true; s.emit('unveil', plaque); s.phase === 'unveil'; s.unveil.plaque = { chassis, points, bestCombo, t }, taken from progress (chassis, points, bestCombo, t). progress.bestCombo is the largest combo of any hit in the story, updated by every impact and by writeOff. s.continueUnveil() leaves 'unveil'. StorySim.step holds in 'unveil' as it does in 'gift'.

probes.say: the certifying write-off reaches phase 'unveil', not the ending at once
the plaque carries the run's chassis, points, best combo and time
one 'unveil' event; the story is already saved complete (the CERTIFIED stamp)
progress keeps the best combo of the run's hits
in the page, the last write-off at the circus reaches the unveiling

requirements.title: Fly the dummy over the river to the ship at Waterfront B3
requirements.statement: After the unveiling, the drone lifts the dummy over the river to the container ship at Waterfront B3. The ending screen follows.
requirements.spec_gap: The GDD does not give the flight's route, its length, where on the ship the dummy is set down, or whether the screen scrolls or cuts from B2 to B3.

touches.why: phase 'voyage': the drone from B2 to the ship in B3, then end('Certified')
the ship's position in B3 as the flight's target
draw the flight; the ending screen after it

requirements.contract: s.continueUnveil() starts phase 'voyage' with s.rescue = { voyage: true, drone, ... } and emits 'voyage' { from: 'B2', to: 'B3' }. The drone flies at proto.droneSpeed and lifts over proto.droneLiftSeconds. On arrival at the ship it emits 'voyage-end', s.screenName() is 'B3', and s.end('Certified') sets phase 'ending'.

probes.say: continuing the unveiling starts the voyage with the drone at work
the voyage ends at the ship in B3, then the Certified ending
guard: with the voyage built, an Arcade Waterfront run never enters unveil or voyage
in the page, A on the unveiling starts the flight to the ship

requirements.spec_gap: The GDD does not say whether the faces show from the start or only in the finale, or which face art is used (the welcome wall's face is the nearest match). Under the tile-art rule the faces are cosmetic only.

touches.why: draw the face on each crate; expose the ship on the scene

requirements.contract: H.scene(s, 'B3').containerShip = { x, y, crates, face: true } in Story's Waterfront under world.storyArt. Cosmetic only: no solid, floor, stair, spawn or cone home changes. The 6.10 world has no containerShip.

probes.say: Story's Waterfront B3 ship marks its crates with the face

requirements.title: Barks name the tile, not the district
requirements.statement: Barks name the tile. Today they still name the district.
requirements.spec_gap: Manual review (29 October): the GDD names the gap but not the lines. Naming a tile means new bark lines in the fleet database, in each tier's voice, with the lore check (Assignment 4's pipeline), not a word swap in game.js. Run 20261029-105801's write replaced the district's name with the tile code ('B2. I did not sign up for this.'); it met its one probe and was reverted.

touches.why: the place a bark names

requirements.contract: window.__dummiesUI.barkPlace(sim) returns the place word barkLine uses: the tile's code or title in Story, not the district's name.
